description: Labelled boxes for the reference tissue classifier, proposed by tools/refmask_train.py propose: box 10 um, margin 10 um all round inside the classifier's mask (reference tissue) or inside tissue with no mask, candidate or background (other). Drawn from the classifier's own mask, so only a person's check of the pictures validates them. 'dataset' names map to a config and volume (--dataset NAME=CONFIG,VOLUME); boxes in that volume's stored voxels (x0, y0, x1, y1; x1/y1 exclusive), plane z; 'id' is per plane. Boxes of one plane must not overlap.
